messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up team 1: were ready to roll the regional handbook v2.1 next Wednesday. This is a localization + small policy tidy: updated parental leave tables for UK/IE, clarified expense caps, and a new data-processing clause for EU employees. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/v2.1-localized
Jorge (HR Ops): Nice. Are we doing a required manager acknowledgement or just individual e-signs?
Maya (People Ops): Manager ack required. Well collect manager confirmations (simple e-sign) and run mandatory 20-min syncs for managers. Sheet with manager list + e-sign column here: https://sheets.goo.gl/rdwd-handbook-acks. Please don't edit rows other than your region.
Nina (EMEA Partner): Ill validate the IE/UK parental numbers. Also: for DE/FR we need a statutory phrasing for the data clause, per local counsel.
Thomas (Legal): Confirmed. I left language suggestions in the doc comments under 5.3. Will add the statutory note for DE/FR tonight.
Jorge (HR Ops): Scheduling: three manager sessions to cover timezones: Mon 0800 UTC (EMEA), Tue 1200 UTC (US overlap), Wed 2300 UTC (APAC). Each 20 min + 10min buffer. Recordings posted.
Maya (People Ops): Can people add RSVP preferences to the sheet. We'll auto-assign if you don't pick one by EOD Friday.
Nina (EMEA Partner): Also flagging hiring ops: several open reqs still list "4 weeks parental leave" in benefits; we need to align to the new tables before reposting. I can scan active reqs and tag the owners.
Jorge (HR Ops): Good call. Hiring leads: search JDs for "parental" and "relocation" and tag me if they contain legacy numbers.
Maya (People Ops): Manager checklist to paste into the sheet (short):
```
- Confirm localized section with regional partner
- Complete e-sign ack for manager responsibilities
- Share recording with direct reports within 48h
- Book 1:1 for any policy exceptions
```
AckBot: Auto-report: 18/60 managers confirmed, 2 sessions full, 1 session pending translation Q&A. Reminder emails will go out 48h before session.
Thomas (Legal): One implementation note: expense cap adjustment requires a short FAQ entry about reimbursable categories. Ill draft 3 bullets and drop in the handbook doc.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks  please leave FAQ bullets in the doc under "Expense questions". Also, Nina, if you sign off on DE wording we can publish localized PDF for EU.
Nina (EMEA Partner): I'll sign off after legal's caveat is in. Plan to sign by tomorrow midday CET.
Jorge (HR Ops): Ops reminder: when exports complete well generate the ack CSV and upload to HRIS. Target upload: Friday 18:00 UTC.
Maya (People Ops): Final deadline for manager confirms: next Friday 18:00 UTC. If you can't make the live slots, mark RSVP and we'll assign a recording + 1:1.
AckBot: Note: e-sign link will be sent in the calendar invite. Current stats: 18 confirmed, 30 pending, 12 unassigned. :white_check_mark:
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll post a short summary in #general 24h before publication. Anything else?
Jorge (HR Ops): Ill follow up with hiring ops and push JD updates.
Thomas (Legal): I'll finish the DE/FR statutory caveats and FAQ bullets tonight.
Nina (EMEA Partner): Will chase managers in EMEA and update the sheet. :thumbsup:
